findings: The actual uniform Fin20 PMF yields an exchangeable joint score law under every coordinate permutation.
The scores are realized as absolute residuals of a fixed zero predictor.
Calibration maximum failure occurs exactly when the high coordinate is the test; probability1/20 and actualsuccess19/20<99/100.
Dependence is permitted by the unconditional exchangeability guarantee; IID is unnecessary for this counterexample.
limits: Does not assert conditional-on-calibration coverage or reuse specific worked calibration observations.
